cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.
